item.title: School Cell Phone Bans and Student Achievement (NBER Digest)
item.description:
📝 An all-day cell phone ban within a Florida school district improved test scores, particularly for male students and in middle and high schools. Elevated disciplinary rates persisted for the full school year. There were no statistically significant changes in test scores during the first year of the ban, when disciplinary rates were high.
🔗 Read more: https://www.nber.org/digest/202512/school-cell-phone-bans-and-student-achievement
